That night he lit the lamp brighter than ever, as if the beam might reach backward through time to the man who once watched this same dark horizon, hoping someone, somewhere, would answer.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡，街道空旷而安静。路灯投下橘黄的光晕，照着湿漉漉的柏油路。早班的清洁工推着车缓缓走过，远处偶有货车的轰鸣。便利店的灯依旧亮着，收银员打着哈欠。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，星光渐淡。几只麻雀在电线上醒来，试探着鸣叫。这是城市最温柔的时刻，白昼尚未降临，喧嚣还未苏醒，只有沉默的楼宇与微凉的风，守着黎明到来之前最后的宁静。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It keeps going smaller until it hits an easy case it already knows how to answer.\n- Like standing between two mirrors: each reflection contains a tinier copy of itself."}
